map.：按体重法：6kg×150ml/kg = 900ml。按月龄参考表，4 月龄参考: : by weight method: 6 kg x 150 ml/kg = 900 ml. By age reference, 4 months reference is 900 ml (refMap[4]=900). Daily suggested = round((900+900)/2) = 900 ml; per meal = round(900/6) = 150 ml. That is about 900 ml/day, 150 ml/meal.
map.宝宝每餐吃不到建议量怎么办？: What if the baby does not finish the suggested amount per meal?
map.奶量按体重与月龄取均值仅是参考，个体差异大。若宝宝精神好、体重稳定增长、每日尿湿: Milk by weight and age as an average is only a reference; individual variation is large. If the baby is alert, gains weight steadily, and wets >= 6 diapers daily, forcing feeds is usually unnecessary; frequent spit-up/bloating can mean reduce and check feeding posture and burping.
map.6 月龄后奶量会下降吗？: Will milk volume drop after 6 months?
